scope: Agent-reviewed development diagnosis; no training, model/default changes or hidden geometry scoring

model_method_mapping.usgs_after: old Korea passed through --old-model; not USGS-only

diagnostic_scope.counters: window aggregate unless target trace explicitly recorded; localization uses local bbox plus tree origin

reference_correction.timing: post-execution / before any new-case output review; see reference-scope-pre-review-audit.json

blue_a.conclusion: A root-component bridge remote from the frozen target sets the window-wide skip. These logs do not establish whether the target text detector would succeed if called.

blue_o.scoring_revision_note: Subsequent v2 clips scored visible arms to unchanged prompts; it changes none of the inputs or pipeline diagnostics used here.
blue_o.distance_definition: Euclidean distance between closed continuous xyxy rectangle boundary closures; separate from the existing-blue pixel-center metric.
blue_o.conclusion: Detection runs, but no returned proposal covers the frozen O-left-stem target. Aggregate arm-tangent rejections concern the other proposed regions and must not be attributed to O.

limits: Target-region coverage, model mixing, connector admission and final route selection are distinct stages.
A skipped detector cannot be labelled a detector failure; a returned-region aggregate rejection cannot be labelled a target-specific connector failure.
No counterfactual connector or relaxed gate was tested. Changing the gate is not proven to improve target geometry.
Distances to saved ordinary paths include product smoothing; unsmoothed predecessor geometry was not present in the NPZ cache.
All selected crops are existing validation/development pixels; Calibration/Holdout remained sealed.

next_experiment_order: Test narrow heterogeneous word-group seed with one branched component plus compact aligned non-repeating contextual components. No endpoint/contact guards relaxed.
Once the target proposal exists, remeasure original native endpoint, arm, uniqueness and display collision reasons with unchanged guards.
Separately ablate continuity-bridge target relevance while preserving the currently successful a/numeric cases.
Expand independently reviewed development positives/negatives before deciding on further augmentation/training; leave this diagnostic set and official holdout out of training.
